description: A key holds the name a consumer can see. TypeScript's binder gives a member starting with `__` a third underscore before filing it, so `Api#__decode` is the key and `Api#___decode` — the compiler's spelling, written here alongside it — colors nothing. `api.decode` is the control: uncolored, it floors, so the green line above it is the entry working rather than the fixture being quiet.

diagnostics.message: Call to `api.decode` escapes this `@nothrow` function: it is declared without a body — an ambient declaration, a `.d.ts`, or a value known only by its function type — and no mark, manifest, overlay, override or baseline entry colors it, so it is assumed to throw. Your outs, in precedence order: bridge this call with `try`/`catch`; assert the color in `nothrow.overrides.json`; install or write an `@no-throw/*` overlay; or, if you own the package, ship a manifest with `nothrow emit`.
